michatheme-v5.description: Settings, license and plugin recommendations for the theme

common.loadFailed: The data could not be loaded. Please reload the page or try again later.
common.readOnly: You have read-only access. Changing is not possible.
common.noTheme: The MichaThemeV5 theme was not found. Please check under Extensions that the plugin is installed and active.

settings.title: Settings
settings.saving: Saving. The theme is being recompiled, this can take up to a minute.
settings.saved: Saved. The changes show in the shop as soon as the theme is compiled.
settings.savedCorrected: Saved. 1 invalid entry was not accepted and is back to default. | Saved. {count} invalid entries were not accepted and are back to default.
settings.saveFailed: Saving did not work. Please try again. Details are in the Shopware log.
settings.unsaved: No changes | 1 change not saved | {count} changes not saved
settings.leave: There are unsaved changes. Really leave this page?
settings.intro: All values are stored in the normal theme configuration (Content, Themes). Both ways change the same thing.

presets.title: Design presets
presets.intro: A preset sets several settings at once. It only takes effect after “Save” and can still be changed before.
presets.applied: Preset “{name}” applied: 1 setting changed. Not saved yet. | Preset “{name}” applied: {count} settings changed. Not saved yet.
presets.appliedNone: Preset “{name}” applied. Nothing needed to change.

standard.label: Default
standard.help: The default: red accent, soft corners, normal spacing, soft shadows, solid buttons. Custom colors are cleared.

glass.label: Glass
glass.help: Round corners and soft shadows. The glass effect for surfaces comes with a later update of the Shopware theme.

compact.label: Compact
compact.help: Less spacing and sharper corners: more products at a glance. The wider content width comes with a later update.

filter.title: Search and filter
filter.simpleHint: “Simple” shows the most important settings. “Expert” shows all of them.

field.law: Legally required, please change with care.
field.mediaHelp: Choose an image from the media library.

colors.title: Custom colors
colors.intro: Leave empty to keep the theme default. Light and dark are set separately. The check below shows whether text stays readable.
colors.warningsHint: Only pairs where you set a color are checked (goal: at least 4.5 to 1 for text).
colors.warnNone: No custom colors set, nothing to check.
colors.paletteHint: The color picker stores up to 12 colors for the whole shop. They appear in every color picker.
colors.paletteFailed: The palette could not be saved.
colors.accentCheck: Accent color: contrast light {light} to 1, dark {dark} to 1 ({state}).

license.title: Licenses
license.grace: The license server was not reachable, the last checked state applies.
license.domain: Checked for the domain {domain}. The license applies to the domain stored in the license.

reason.no_token: No license code entered. The theme runs with all free features.
reason.unreachable: The license server is not reachable right now. Free features stay active, your shop keeps running.
reason.token_expired: The license has expired. Free features stay active.
reason.token_revoked: The license was revoked or cancelled. Free features stay active.
reason.domain_mismatch: This license code is not valid for this domain. Free features stay active.
reason.signature_invalid: The license code is not valid. Please check that it was copied completely.
reason.token_malformed: The license code does not look right. Please copy it completely from your customer account.
reason.unknown_tier: The license belongs to no known tier. Free features stay active.
reason.other: The license is invalid. Free features stay active.

license.codeHelp: You find the code in your customer account on theme.michael-gahn.de. After saving it is never shown in plain text again.
license.removeConfirm: Really remove the license code? Pro features are off afterwards.
license.throttled: Please wait a moment and check again.
license.errorFormat: The code does not look right. It has three parts separated by dots. Please copy it completely.
license.errorFailed: That did not work. Please try again later.
license.saving: Saving. The theme is being recompiled, this can take up to a minute.
license.buyText: Pro features and updates are available on the website. Afterwards you find the license code in your customer account.
license.privacy: Only the license code and the domain are sent to theme.michael-gahn.de for checking. Visitors of your shop are not affected.

catalog.title: Plugin recommendations
catalog.intro: More plugins by Michael Gahn DESIGN. Nothing is installed automatically. To install, download the ZIP and upload it under Extensions, My extensions.
catalog.unavailable: The list is not reachable right now. Your shop keeps running normally. Please try again later.
catalog.stale: Note: The list could not be refreshed. You see the last known state.
catalog.throttled: Please wait a moment, the list was just refreshed.
catalog.empty: There are no further plugins for Shopware 6 at the moment.
catalog.privacy: Note: To show the images your browser loads files from theme.michael-gahn.de. The server sees your IP address.

info.title: Info
info.channelsNone: No sales channel is assigned to the theme yet. Assigning is a deliberate click under Content, Themes.
info.themeFound: Theme found and active in the system
info.assigned: Theme is assigned to sales channels
